svg.title: RFP AI system architecture
svg.desc: A browser app talks to a FastAPI backend. The backend has ingest, retrieval, drafting and validation, conflict handling, review, export and chat modules. Only some call a language model, through a gateway that rotates keys across Groq, Gemini and OpenRouter. State lives in local SQLite files.
